name: GM CCA - Ypsilanti Processing Center, Ypsilanti MI

fieldNotes.truckGate: Open campus. The building sits well back behind a large open lawn off E Michigan Ave; multiple driveways enter from the road with no barrier arm, sliding gate, or perimeter fence at the frontage (confirmed in 2025-08 Street View). Trucks reach the north and west dock faces via open internal drives and a shared campus loop road. No controlled truck entrance.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any driveway. The only small standalone structure on the property is a dark-roofed office/support building at the NE corner, set back from the road - not a gate booth beside a controlled lane.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate exists, so no remote check-in either - false.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved aprons and the NW trailer yard inside the property give ample room to hold trucks before the docks - set true at medium confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long banks of dock doors with trailers backed in along the entire north wall (~12-15 doors) and the west wall (~15-18 doors). Estimated ~36 total -> 25-50 band. Low-confidence exact count from overhead roof imagery.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Dedicated trailer-staging yard on the NW corner holds rows of drop trailers (no tractors) plus trailers staged along the west apron; well into the 25-50 band.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Distinct trailer-storage lot NW of the building, separate from the active west/north dock aprons.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Two physically separate dock banks on different building faces (north wall and west wall) suggest split ship/receive flows - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: An active rail line runs SE of the property on the far side of E Michigan Ave, but no spur enters this property - false.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: The processing center is a single large building. It shares a campus to the north with a separate domed GM training/engagement facility, but that is a distinct operation, so multipleFacilities is left false for the processing yard itself.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Ypsilanti, within the dense Detroit-Ann Arbor metro fabric along the E Michigan Ave corridor -> Urban.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~19 acres for the processing operation footprint (building + NW trailer yard + employee parking), measured from the traced perimeter ring.
